## Article Checklist

If this PR adds or modifies an article, please verify:

- [ ] Frontmatter is complete (`title`, `tags`, `categories`, `date`, `id`)
- [ ] Article ID follows the format `Article-Title-YYYY-MM-DD`
- [ ] Structured data (JSON-LD) block is present and valid
- [ ] Content has been proofread for grammar and accuracy
- [ ] All sources and references are credited
- [ ] No sensitive or confidential information is included
- [ ] Category is appropriate (`News`, `Events`, etc.)
- [ ] Tags are relevant and consistent with existing taxonomy

## Type of Change

- [ ] New article
- [ ] Article correction / update
- [ ] Typo / formatting fix
- [ ] Repository infrastructure (README, templates, etc.)
